skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — create a video with visuals synced to this music track — and get music-syn...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Generator From Music: create AI-generated music-synced videos from audio files.
- Supports MP3, WAV, AAC, FLAC uploads up to 200MB; return 1080p MP4 in 1–2 minutes.
- Automated session handling with easy, free sign-in using a generated token.
- Simple prompts to generate, export, and manage credits or session status.
- Designed for musicians, content creators, and marketers—no manual video editing required.
